facets.la: De matrimonio, dote et bonis familiae
De dominio, possessione et iuribus in re
De credito, pignoribus, usuris et mercatura
De statutis, iurisdictione et potestate publica

concepts.scope: Validity of a will as to form: witnesses, notary, nuncupative/written will, testamentum inter liberos, statutory form.
Who can make a will or take under it (filiusfamilias, condemned, religious, insane, women under statute).
Validity, meaning and effect of naming heirs; universal succession under a will.
Construing the testator's words and presumed intention (who is meant by 'filii', 'descendentes', 'familia' etc.).
Codicils, conversion of a failed testament via the codicillary clause.
Later wills, express or tacit revocation, ademption of legacies.

concepts.en: Conditions and modus in last wills
concepts.de: Bedingungen und Auflagen in letztwilligen Verfügungen
concepts.scope: Conditions attached to institutions, legacies or fideicommissa, their fulfilment and validity (incl. 'si sine liberis decesserit').
Omission or disinheritance of children/parents, just causes of disinheritance, rupture of a testament.

concepts.en: Forced share and querela inofficiosi testamenti
concepts.scope: The children's/parents' legitimate portion and remedies against an inofficious will.
Heir's right to retain a quarter against legacies.
Fiduciary heir's quarter against universal fideicommissa.
Substitute heir if the first does not become heir.
Substitution for a child dying before puberty, or for an insane descendant.
Trusts in wills: universal or singular fideicommissa, restitution by the fiduciary, fideicommissary substitution, tacit fideicommissa.

concepts.en: Family fideicommissum and prohibition to alienate outside the family
concepts.de: Familienfideikommiss und Veräußerungsverbot außerhalb der Familie
concepts.la: fideicommissum familiae; prohibitio alienandi extra familiam
concepts.scope: Keeping property in the lineage: successive calls of agnates, prohibition of alienation extra familiam, primogeniture-like arrangements.
Validity, object, extent, delivery and lapse of legacies; legatees' rights.

concepts.en: Legacies and dispositions for pious causes
concepts.de: Vermächtnisse und Verfügungen zu frommen Zwecken
concepts.scope: Dispositions for the soul, churches, hospitals, the poor; privileges of pious causes (formal leniency, Falcidia).
Donations mortis causa and their treatment like legacies.
Powers, duties and accountability of executors of wills.
Order of heirs without a will under ius commune (Nov. 118) or statute; degrees and classes.

concepts.en: Statutory exclusion of women and cognates
concepts.de: Statutarischer Ausschluss von Frauen und Kognaten
concepts.scope: Statutes preferring males/agnates, exclusion of dowered daughters and their descendants, 'favor agnationis'.

concepts.la: successio matris; SC Tertullianum et Orphitianum
concepts.scope: Mother's rights in her children's inheritance and vice versa; uterine siblings.

concepts.en: Representation and per stirpes / per capita division
concepts.de: Eintrittsrecht und Teilung nach Stämmen oder Köpfen
concepts.la: ius repraesentationis; successio in stirpes vel in capita
concepts.scope: Grandchildren/nephews taking a predeceased parent's place; how shares are counted.
What happens to a failed share among co-heirs/co-legatees.

concepts.en: Acceptance, repudiation and transmission of inheritance
concepts.de: Antritt, Ausschlagung und Transmission der Erbschaft
concepts.scope: Entering upon or refusing an inheritance; transmission of the right to accept; abstention.

concepts.en: Benefit of inventory and heirs' liability for debts
concepts.de: Inventarwohltat und Haftung der Erben für Schulden
concepts.scope: Limiting the heir's liability; separation of estates; heirs' liability for the deceased's debts.
Bringing prior gifts/dowries into the account among descendants.
Dividing an inheritance among co-heirs, and validity of partitions.
Institution, disinheritance or preterition of postumi; rupture of a will by a later-born child (legal-technical side; the bodily side is Layer B).
Who died first; predecease; presumptions about survival.

concepts.en: Reversion of property to donors or their line
concepts.de: Rückfall von Gütern an Schenker oder ihre Linie
concepts.scope: Return of dowries, gifts or fiefs to the giver or his family on a condition or death.
Lapsed dispositions; inheritance without heirs; fisc's claim.
Consent, words of present tense, publicity, clandestine marriage, proof of marriage. (Bodily aspects -> Layer B.)
Engagement, its breach and penalties, arrhae sponsaliciae.
Consanguinity, affinity, spiritual kinship, vows as impediments; papal dispensation.
Who must dower, amount (dos congrua), promise, payment, dowry funds.
Return of dowry at the end of marriage; wife's priority and tacit hypothec; dowry insurance/security.

concepts.en: Statutory gains of dowry and marital survivorship gains
concepts.de: Statutarischer Mitgiftgewinn und Gewinn des überlebenden Ehegatten
concepts.scope: Husband's or wife's gain of dowry/ donatio at death by statute or pact.
Daughters' renunciation of paternal inheritance in exchange for dowry, often sworn; its validity.

concepts.en: Marital gifts and donatio propter nuptias
concepts.la: donatio propter nuptias; donatio inter virum et uxorem
concepts.scope: Counter-dowry, gifts between spouses and their invalidity.
Wife's property outside the dowry; husband's administration.
Penalties and restrictions on remarrying spouses, especially toward children of the first marriage (property side).
Widow's maintenance, residence, usufruct, tutela of children.
Duty to maintain children, parents, spouses, illegitimate children.
Computing degrees and defining relatives where this is the issue (statutes, fideicommissa).

concepts.en: Family and fraternal community of goods
concepts.la: fraterna societas; communio bonorum inter fratres
concepts.scope: Brothers or relatives living and trading together; presumptions about acquisitions.
Father's power over children, its effects on contracts, acquisitions, litigation.
Release from paternal power; form, proof and effects.
Property of sons in power; father's usufruct.
Minors' capacity, age thresholds, protection of minors (except restitutio in integrum -> PROC).
Appointment, powers, liability and accounts of tutors; mothers as tutors.
Curators for adults under disability and for goods.
Women's capacity to contract, litigate, act without a guardian/mundualdus (Velleianum -> CRED).
Status of children as legitimate/illegitimate and legitimation, where the legal status (not the body) is at issue. Linked to Layer B birth_status.
Who is a citizen or forensis; domicile for jurisdiction, taxes, statutes.

concepts.en: Religious profession and its property effects
concepts.scope: Entry into religion and the professed person's capacity, inheritance and property.
Absent persons, presumption of death, administration of their goods.
Legal effects of exile/outlawry and condemnation on property and capacity.
Infamia and its consequences on office, testimony, capacity.
Legal position of Jews (contracts, lending, testimony, conversion, inheritance).
Slaves and manumission (personal status, not praedial servitudes).
Title, transfer of ownership, vindication, direct vs useful dominion.
Acquisition, loss and protection of possession; quasi-possession of rights; possessory judgment.

concepts.en: Spoliation and restitution of the despoiled
concepts.scope: Remedy of the despoiled; exceptio spolii.
Acquisition of property or rights by lapse of time, good faith and title (limitation of actions -> PROC).
Praedial and personal servitudes other than usufruct: ways, light, walls, drainage.
Use of rivers and channels, mills, alluvion, islands, flooding.
Creation, extent and end of usufruct (incl. widow's usufruct).
Perpetual leases, canon, devolution for non-payment, alienation of the emphyteutic right.
Boundary disputes and markers.
Rights among co-owners, division of common things.
Legal or contractual prohibitions to alienate (dotal land, pupils' property, pacts de non alienando); outside the family-fideicommissum case.
Who takes fruits; reimbursement of expenses and improvements; possessor in good/bad faith.
Formation, price, delivery, risk, redemption pacts, retrait (ius protimiseos).
Rescission for grossly unjust price.
Seller's liability when the buyer is evicted.
Leases of land, houses, work; remission of rent for bad harvest.
Commercial or agrarian partnerships (soccida), profit sharing, liability of partners.
Mandate, representation by procurators/agents outside litigation.
Managing another's affairs without mandate.
Deposits, bailment, commodatum.

concepts.en: Stipulation, pacts and enforceability of promises
concepts.de: Stipulation, Pakten und Klagbarkeit von Versprechen
concepts.scope: Form and binding force of promises; nude pacts; clauses in notarial contracts.
Validity, insinuation, revocation for ingratitude, gifts by minors/sons in power.

concepts.la: iuramentum in contractibus; c. Quamvis pactum
concepts.scope: Sworn contracts and renunciations; whether an oath validates an otherwise void act.
Transfer of claims and substitution of obligations.
Performance, release, receipts, set-off, acceptilatio.
Vitiated consent, duress, simulated contracts, fraud on creditors (actio Pauliana).

concepts.en: Recovery of undue payments and unjust enrichment
concepts.de: Rückforderung ungeschuldeter Leistungen und ungerechtfertigte Bereicherung
concepts.scope: Restitution of what was paid or given without cause.
Settlement of doubtful claims by agreement and its rescission.
Standards of care and liability for loss; force majeure.
Compensation for loss, lucrum cessans, damnum emergens (distinct from usury).

concepts.en: Conditions, terms and penalty clauses in contracts
concepts.de: Bedingungen, Fristen und Strafklauseln in Verträgen
concepts.scope: Conditional and time-bound promises, impossible conditions, penalty stipulations and their incurring (conditions in last wills -> succ_conditions).
Obligations unenforceable at law but with some effects.
Prohibition of interest, disguised usury, restitution of usury, public lenders.
Purchase of annual rents, their lawfulness and redemption.
Money exchange and exchange contracts.
Loans for consumption, repayment, proof of loans.
Security rights, tacit hypothecs, sale of pledges.
Ranking of creditors, bankruptcy of merchants, cessio bonorum.
Sureties, benefit of discussion (excussio), co-sureties.
Invalidity of women's suretyship for others and its renunciation.
Liability of co-debtors in solidum.
Which coin or value is owed, changes in currency value, payment in estimation, debasement.
Merchant practice, account books as proof, guild rules, commercial customs.
What a fief is; investiture and its proof; feudum vs other tenures.
Who succeeds in a fief: descendants, agnates, women, feudum paternum vs novum.
Sale, subinfeudation, lord's consent.
Loss of fief for disloyalty or failure of service.
Oath of fidelity, services, homage.
Provision, collation, plurality, vacancy, prebends.
Presentation rights of lay or clerical patrons.
Canonical elections, chapters' consent, confirmation.
Administration and alienation of church goods, solemnities, papal licence.
Tithe obligations, exemptions, novalia.

concepts.en: Ecclesiastical jurisdiction and privilege of forum
concepts.scope: Competence of church courts over clerics and mixed matters; conflicts with secular courts.

concepts.en: Ecclesiastical immunity and taxation of clergy
concepts.de: Kirchliche Immunität und Besteuerung des Klerus
concepts.scope: Exemption of clerics and church goods from secular burdens.
Rights and property of religious houses, mendicants, hospitals as institutions.
Force and interpretation of papal letters, dispensations, delegations.
Censures, their validity and effects.
Clerical status, residence, clerics' wills and property (clerical continence -> Layer B).
Which judge may hear the case (domicile, contract, situs, prorogation).
Valid summons, default, proceedings against absent parties.

concepts.en: Libel, pleading and joinder of issue
concepts.scope: Framing the claim, exceptions, joinder of issue.
Who must prove what; kinds and force of presumptions.
Admissibility, number, credibility of witnesses; testimony de auditu, fama.
Proof by documents, notarial practice, public faith, forgery allegations in civil cases.
Judicial/extrajudicial confession; decisive and supplementary oaths.
Form and effect of sentences, interlocutory vs definitive, res judicata.
When a judicial or legal act is void, and how nullity is raised.
Appeal and its effects, time limits, inappellable matters.
Arbitrators and arbitratores, compromise, awards and their review.

concepts.en: Execution of judgments and instruments; imprisonment for debt
concepts.de: Vollstreckung von Urteilen und Urkunden; Schuldhaft
concepts.scope: Enforcement, execution on goods, instrumenta guarentigiata, debt imprisonment.
Effect of protests and reservations made to preserve rights.
Clementine Saepe, summary cases.

concepts.en: Time limits and limitation of actions
concepts.scope: Deadlines in procedure and extinction of actions by time.
Extraordinary restoration of minors, absent persons etc.
Powers and limits of delegated judges.
Representation in court, mandate proof, syndics of communities.
Killing, self-defence, fratricide/parricide.
Bodily harm and assault (non-sexual).
Theft, robbery, receiving.
Forgery of documents, coins, seals as crime.
Perjury as crime or sin.
Treason, rebellion, public enemies.
Insult and defamation.
Accusatorial vs inquisitorial process, ex officio proceedings, indicia.
Conditions and use of torture.
Death penalty, fines, confiscation, penal effects on heirs.
Pardons, private peace agreements, amnesties.
Mental element, attempt, accessories, mandators of crimes.
Safe-conducts, securitas, their breach.

concepts.en: Validity and scope of municipal statutes
concepts.scope: Power of cities to legislate; statutes against ius commune or canon law; whom statutes bind.
Strict vs extensive interpretation of statutes; statutes as odious/favourable; relation to ius commune.

concepts.de: Statutenkollision und Geltung außerhalb des Territoriums
concepts.scope: Which city's statute applies to foreigners, property elsewhere, contracts made elsewhere.
Validity, proof and force of custom.
Grant, interpretation, revocation of privileges (non-ecclesiastical).
Emperor/prince's power, vicariates, plenitude of power, lords' authority.
Podestà, councils, officials' powers and syndication.
Jurisdiction of lords and cities over territories and castles; high justice.
Direct and indirect taxes, tolls, estimo/cadastre, exemptions from burdens.
Rights of the treasury, confiscated and vacant goods.
Legal personality, acts and liability of communities, guilds, colleges.

concepts.en: Reprisals, war and peace between powers
concepts.de: Repressalien, Krieg und Frieden zwischen Mächten
concepts.scope: Reprisals against foreigners, just war, treaties.
Where a fiction is argued (e.g. unborn as born, return of property).
Whether acts, ratifications or conditions act retroactively.
Later law or clause derogating from earlier; general vs special.
Where conscience/equity/natural law is invoked against strict law.
Effects of ignorance on acts and penalties.
Silence, tacit approval, later ratification of acts.
